summary: Weakest area: Instagram reels lose 77% of viewers in the first 3 seconds — hooks fail to stop the scroll. Animated ads posts perform at 0.62× median. Bio violates rules: niche/region targeting, 24‑hr promise, free offer outside website posts.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: **contrast** (1.75× in learning loop) or **question** (1.75×); avoid **top3** (used 10‑26) and **comparison** (0.94×).
- Topics to avoid: repeating “caption ignored” or “budget vs crew” angles already posted 10‑26 and 10‑30.
- Reminder: every post must read like a developer sharing real work, never an ad. Offer only “pay after approval” + a short DM conversation. No demos, free audits, or guarantees.

instructions.research: List 3 common video‑ad pain points for small businesses across India (e.g., high production cost, low watch time, hard to update) without naming a single niche.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two published animated‑ads posts (10‑26 top3, 10‑30 question) — note hook, format, engagement — and identify why both fell below median.
instructions.writer: Write one Instagram post for AI animated ads using a **contrast hook** (e.g., ‘Static image vs. motion: what actually stops the scroll?’). Keep it developer‑voice, mention pay‑after‑approval, invite DM for honest fit advice. No demo claims, no niche targeting.
instructions.image: Create a single static image in **silhouette style** (best image style 1.5×) showing a split frame: left side a flat product photo, right side the same product with subtle motion lines. No text overlay; caption carries the message.
instructions.video: If making a Reel, front‑load the contrast in the first 2 seconds (static → animated cut). Keep total length ≤15 s. Add captions for sound‑off viewing. Do not show a client project — use a generic product example.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to remove niche list, region, 24‑hr promise, and free site check. Replace with: ‘Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads & lead gen for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.’
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian small‑business accounts (cafes, gyms, D2C brands) about their video content struggles — no self‑promotion.
Reply to any existing DM or comment on your own posts within 2 hours to signal responsiveness.
